caption: The drawing features a single hand tool prominently colored in shades of brown and metallic gray. The tool has a curved, serrated blade on one end that is metallic gray, attached to a wooden handle that is light to medium brown with darker grain patterns. The metal part near the handle includes a brass-colored ferrule connecting the blade and handle. Below the colored illustration, there are three smaller, lightly sketched line drawings of the same tool: one showing the side profile and two showing the blade from above and beneath, all in faint gray pencil. The background is light tan with a uniform, slightly speckled texture, and near the bottom of the image, the name "H. Boyd Gilmore" is faintly written in small block letters.
title: Wooden Peg File
